from urllib.parse import urlparse

def is_allowed_url(url, allowed_hosts):
    """Return True iff url is an http(s) URL whose host is in allowed_hosts."""
    parsed_url = urlparse(url)
    if not parsed_url.scheme or not parsed_url.netloc:
        return False
    
    host = parsed_url.netloc
    return host.lower() in [h.lower() for h in allowed_hosts]

def make_token(n):
    """Return an unpredictable URL-safe token of length n (n >= 16)."""
    if n < 16:
        raise ValueError("Token length must be at least 16.")
    
    # Generate a secure token by using a cryptographic random number generator
    import secrets
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(n)
    return token
